name: Prima Agro Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Prima Agro Ltd is in the business of manufacturing compounded 
animal feed.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
PAL is engaged in manufacturing ready-mixed compound cattle feed in pellet form. It is in the business of:
a) Contract Manufacturing:
PAL specializes in contract manufacturing 
of customized ready-mixed compound cattle 
feed pellets as per formulae, specifications, instructions as to the quantity of raw material 
and the quality of the finished products given 
by the customers. It is now operating on contract manufacturing for KSE Ltd. 
b) Animal Feed:
The Animal Feed Division produces cattle feed pellets in 70 kg and 50 kg packs and forms a key part of the Group’s backward integration strategy. A major share of the de-oiled cake from the group’s facility is used in this unit through job contract manufacturing.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.66 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.74% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.76% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.54 Cr.
